info.title: XSS PDF Solutions Universal API
info.description: PDF document automation tools from Cross Service Solutions, including PDF merge, compression, conversion, protection, unlocking, metadata removal, flattening, and AI question answering.

post.description: Creates answers from a PDF in XSS PDF Solutions.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

file.description: The PDF file to be analyzed by AI.
file.example: Upload a PDF, or use the default sample PDF URL.

questtext.description: The question related to the content of the PDF.
questtext.example: Ask a question about the PDF.
questtext.default: What text is in this PDF?

result.description: Detailed AI answer or operation result.

content.description: Output file content when returned inline.

path.description: URL to access the output file.

status.description: The current status of the process.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
